pull_requests.title: fix: stabilize macOS engineering checks and bind reviewed source
pull_requests.head: ae77486dab0141173fcb2c4c99dd85d34e888157
pull_requests.body:
## Problem

The engineering checks exposed macOS build warnings in Linux-only helpers and a failure when the scale supervisor test first launched a fresh helper. These prevented the original ordered engineering commands from completing on the macOS execution host. The underlying cause of the earlier fresh-helper failure remains undetermined. The change below establishes the fixture's prepared-helper precondition; it does not claim to repair the old A23 cold-start failure.

## Changes

This PR builds on the snapshot batching source already merged in #170 and adds four source changes:

- Gate the private Linux-only Python inventory helpers, semantic-test imports, and benchmark-adapter test support with their existing platform condition.
- Prepare the supervisor test's exact helper once using the existing setup supervisor, checking successful exit, the passed summary, complete stderr, and cleanup. Then run the original 250 ms deadline assertion on that prepared helper.
- Retain the production supervisor clock and deadline handling, the negative 1 ms control, and the existing non-Linux restricted-network behavior.

The remaining files record the exact source review, original execution logs, and the matching v15 source binding.

## Fixed source and independent review

- Product P: `b413f7882d8bf65f93a6ff3d07e0c17706d95d69`
- Review R: `dd1d00a3bf18d9025fc48222ffe0d21896c26da5`
- Candidate G: `ae77486dab0141173fcb2c4c99dd85d34e888157`
- Parent integration: `26768b5e38ed1784bf77a8c4fe57baf01a19c626`
- [Canonical independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/ae77486dab0141173fcb2c4c99dd85d34e888157/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-macos-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json)
- [Installed evidence manifest](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/ae77486dab0141173fcb2c4c99dd85d34e888157/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-macos-integration-bfcc-20261009/installed-review-manifest.json)

Independent review covers all 1,089 product inputs, all 44 deltas from the historical source base, and all 138 ordinary validation inputs. The G verifier changes only its four source/review/path/digest constants; the registry matches the committed review. Original proof logic and CI are retained. The readiness fixture's author is identified separately from its non-author semantic reviewer.

## Actual validation and current status

The four commands below ran once, in order, on the #170 source plus the exact four uncommitted files subsequently committed as P. All four child processes exited 0 with Rust 1.95, SDK 15.4, four build jobs, and default test threads:

```
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
cargo test -p cc-eval -- integration_fixtures_and_corpus
```

The workspace run reported **2,712 passed, 0 failed, 73 existing ignored** across 218 harnesses. The final fixture command passed its one selected test; it is a repeated check, not an additional unique workspace test. The complete source bytes before and after execution match P. Earlier failed attempts remain in their original records.

**Native source-admission outcome:** the extra 181-method entry point on this clean G reached the native runner's actual 3,600-second limit at 07:09:38 UTC. Its log contains 139 completed `ok` methods and no terminal suite summary; the runner reports timeout/exit -1, while the original child exit remains unknown. The later selected v15 CLI in that sequence was **not run**. The verified orphaned child group was terminated and its cleanup and unchanged source were recorded. The original running receipt has not been rewritten as a completed result.

This PR's own GitHub Actions `check` job 113695153145 (run 37892120921) reports success at 06:45:30 UTC; that separate CI result is not relabelled as the incomplete native run. Remaining CI and any further acceptance retain their own actual checkout and evidence. [Original timeout, cleanup, source snapshots and current integration records](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/6e7959f5290f1d03e3e5c736e643c4d23a0b6ec7/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-a23-closeout-20261009-bfcc/round10-source-bindings-and-native-outcomes). The combined successor is #178; its original closeout CI exposed a separate ready-file publication race, now being repaired and reviewed on a new isolated candidate.

## TODO accounting

The original ledger remains **163 done, 29 remaining**. This engineering fix does not close any original TODO. The ten-task closeout still requires its original complete scale-study acceptance; A23 and G2 retain their own source identities and plans. The [original A23 full study](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37872522779) ended in failure at 06:14 UTC after its 100k hosted runner lost communication; its original aggregate is failed with 146 missing shards. This engineering change does not convert that incomplete study into a pass.

pull_requests.title: fix: use Rust for legacy runtime latency quantiles
pull_requests.head: 840fa2e0a26ab60c138747a4309aba5df506edc1
pull_requests.body:
## Why

The active runtime report still calculated legacy latency quantiles in Python after running the Rust statistics replay. That left two live owners of the same nearest-rank calculation and made the P8-017 cleanup incomplete.

## What changes

- Add a Rust nanosecond wire adapter that calls the existing `nearest_rank` implementation and preserves the original all-terminal-outcome populations, nulls, field names and nanosecond precision.
- Have the Rust replay produce the legacy all/read/build summaries directly from validated `finished_ns - offered_ns` values.
- Remove Python's duplicate quantile function and copy the same verified `statistics.json` bytes after checking their SHA-256 against the replay receipt.
- Add Rust precision, boundary, empty-group and terminal-outcome controls, plus Python active-copy and post-verification tamper controls.
- Update the runtime evidence guide and bind the fixed source review using only the existing v15 pin mechanism.

The candidate starts from main `60e5ce3ccc86f5cccb40f6f9c32bbc7b77bf1e9d` and retains #170's batching changes. The actual product commit is `bbe7a9e77f332448b610c54460b355c5936e8c2a`, with exactly five changed implementation/test/document paths. The complete domain remains 1,089 product inputs and 138 validation inputs.

## Validation

The final five blobs have been independently read and reviewed by multiple agents, including the actual Git diff and source ancestry. Static review caught an intermediate misplaced test assertion; the final test restores the original successful-observation method exactly.

Compilation and the new controls have not yet run at PR creation. The existing CI and path-triggered runtime workflows must validate this exact candidate with their original workloads and limits. Results will be recorded as they become available.

## Task boundary

This addresses one concrete P8-017 implementation gap. The original 192 task definitions, statuses, dependency graph and P8-005 acceptance subgates are unchanged: **163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed TODOs**. P8-017 remains in progress pending its dependencies and full acceptance.

The original E scale study failed before completing all 150 shards and 1,500 samples, and the original Mac regression remains under separate fixed-source diagnosis. Neither older executions nor the isolated Mac diagnostic are relabelled as evidence for this candidate. This PR grants no live-provider, quality-gate or release certification.

Initial execution head: `9a52cd24337294e70281badc861bda7bdf0a9f0a`. Initial independent review commit: `4e4671482333c1762efa9c5ab9aeceadc0f3e295`.

## Formatter follow-up

The first CI run [37894025756](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37894025756) stopped at `cargo fmt --all --check`: its original check log identified two formatting changes in the newly added Rust tests. That failure remains recorded. The MSRV job for the initial head passed; later check steps were skipped after the formatter failure.

Apply exactly those two formatter outputs, with the complete production prefix and all test values/assertions unchanged. The original failure log and an independent before/after review are retained under `artifacts/checkpoints/p8-runtime-statistics-owner-20261009/formatting-followup/`. No formatter, source-integrity or test gate is weakened.

Current product commit: `98173d7bf3a4709d0309907ec85ff5674c23c921`. Current review commit: `13610caf2904f7656fa45ccbf20f61a313b708b8`. Current execution head: `840fa2e0a26ab60c138747a4309aba5df506edc1`.

Seven original pull-request workflows have been observed starting on the current execution head. Their results are pending; no CI pass or additional completed TODO is claimed by this update.

pull_requests.body:
## Why

#173 and #174 make disjoint engineering changes, but each binds a complete v15 source registry. Combining either old registry with the other PR's source would leave the admitted inputs inconsistent. This PR combines their exact reviewed source changes over fixed main `60e5ce3ccc86f5cccb40f6f9c32bbc7b77bf1e9d` and installs a new complete source binding.

## Changes

- Reuse the bounded public-surface query window only within one prepare call when the final seeds and admission bounds remain valid; preserve the original SQL fallback and epoch fencing.
- Prepare the macOS subprocess test helper before the original 250 ms assertion, and match test-only platform cfg boundaries to their existing callers.
- Preserve all 65 original archive additions from #173/#174 and the original source-specific controls workflow.
- Add an independent review of the actual combined product, then install only the standard schema-10 registry and four immutable v15 pins. Verifier logic, exclusions, historical protections, CI commands, original scale budgets and task definitions are unchanged.

The exact main-to-product scope is five Rust files, 65 new archive files and one retained workflow. PR #175 is outside this fixed candidate.

## Fixed source and review

- Product P: `59c2197ebbada4e8cb2091d2fc7a852aa28c9205`
- Independent review R: `c6c8030d359107c82f0f738d8ef270778b5f887d`
- Execution candidate G: `7b1fc54485bfda1b00f5e316617052900b99fb63`
- Complete product inputs: 1,089; historical delta paths: 44; validation inputs: 139.
- Registry SHA-256: `754442a8ff237eedaebac63aeeb1ae03f4baeb462b2ee1f8d84bada3cb56ee73`.

The [canonical review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/7b1fc54485bfda1b00f5e316617052900b99fb63/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-combined-surface-mac-28fe-20261009/independent-source-review.json) and [detailed review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/7b1fc54485bfda1b00f5e316617052900b99fb63/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-combined-surface-mac-28fe-20261009/independent-review-details.json) bind actual Git contents. Root separately verified that R adds only five review artifacts and G modifies only the two identity files, with unchanged verifier logic.

## Validation and evidence boundary

Both original PRs have passed their own three-job CI. Those results support review of their respective inputs; the combined candidate's original CI has not yet executed at PR creation and must supply its own result. This draft grants no combined runtime, full-scale, platform, quality or release certification.

The old #173 controls workflow keeps its original source guard and branch trigger. It is retained as a validation input and is not reused as a run plan for this combined product.

The A23 scale run `37872522779` ended in failure: its original aggregate reports 146 missing shards after the 100k runner lost communication. All four valid original shards, that failure and the old Mac failure remain historical evidence; none is relabelled for G. A new full study must keep the original five sizes × 30 repetitions, 150 shards and 1,500 composite measurements on its fixed complete source.

## TODO accounting

192 original tasks / 163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed in this round. This integration enables further work and does not close a task by itself.

pull_requests.title: perf(index): integrate bounded FTS rebuilds with reviewed macOS fixes
pull_requests.head: 9f7b16f0758eb79f306cf44605b84550f02de441
pull_requests.body:
## 为什么需要这个组合

全量重建的 FTS 镜像仍按文件/记录逐次写入，大规模阶段会反复支付这部分开销；macOS 上还存在测试辅助代码的 cfg 范围和异步 fixture 就绪问题。这份 PR 将已独立审查的重建路径与 macOS 修复合到 #173 的固定 surface-window 源码上，形成一份可执行完整验收的统一版本。

## 改动

- 保留 #173 的 `reconcile.rs` 原字节和 139 个验证输入，精确整合 4 个 macOS 修复文件与 5 个 FTS 实现/测试文件。
- 重建路径以至多 256 个文件为窗口延迟写入 FTS 镜像；使用实际存活 rowid 范围，保留冲突幸存者、schema/overflow 回退及错误传播。
- 原公开 `write_file_data` 接口保持原有行为；新 opt-in 重建入口要求调用者传播错误、放弃 staging 并禁止发布失败结果。这里不声称 `journal_mode=OFF` 提供物理回滚。
- 新增 9 项普通 FTS 正确性/失败/扫描控制；不把旧原型时间样本转移到此版本。
- 固定独立产品/审查/绑定链：P `9d13cb30dd618bc5d106186711c1d98e01b47995` → R `6f11ae6904fd8d08fec4b4abd83f510cedcba6c8` → G `9f7b16f0758eb79f306cf44605b84550f02de441`。R 仅添加审查与原始执行归档；G 仅更新原 v15 的四个引用和匹配 registry。
- 完整清单为 1,090 个产品输入、139 个验证输入，以及相对固定历史 BASE 的 46 项源码差异；原协议、预算、CI 和校验逻辑保持原字节。

## 实际验证与来源

原四条工程命令全部真实退出 0：

1. `cargo +1.95.0 fmt --all -- --check`
2. `cargo +1.95.0 clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
3. `cargo +1.95.0 test --workspace`：2,727 passed / 0 failed / 73 原有 ignored；未新增 skip/ignore。
4. `cargo +1.95.0 test -p cc-eval -- integration_fixtures_and_corpus`：1 passed，属于前述 workspace 的重复确认。

上述实际运行发生在 #173 G `275e8799…` 加 9 个冻结未提交文件的工作树，随后与产品 P 做了完整字节、Git blob 和 mode 桥接；不能重标为直接 checkout P/G 的运行。每条命令前后全部 1,232 个输入不变。目标目录由已结束的上一轮依赖缓存作 APFS clone，属于普通工程验证，不是冷构建证明。

独立审查和全部原件入口：
[`artifacts/checkpoints/p8-combined-engineering-bfcc-20261009/`](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/9f7b16f0758eb79f306cf44605b84550f02de441/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-combined-engineering-bfcc-20261009/)

**G9f 的真实 CI 失败及第 11 轮修复：**本 PR 的 P7 closeout run 37896539239 / job 113709066322 在 07:08:55 UTC 结束为 failure；原命令 `cargo test -p cc-semantic --locked --all-targets -- --nocapture` 返回 101，`independently_observed_sigkill_boundaries` 读取 ready 文件时出现 `ParseIntError { kind: Empty }`。源码显示原 helper 先创建最终 ready 文件再写 PID，parent 仅等文件存在；没有留存实际 seed/PID/系统调用交错，不虚构更细根因。原日志、原始 artifact ZIP 和审查已[完整保留](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/6e7959f5290f1d03e3e5c736e643c4d23a0b6ec7/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-a23-closeout-20261009-bfcc/round10-source-bindings-and-native-outcomes)。

第 11 轮在独立工作树中仅修复该 fixture 的发布顺序：先在同目录完整写入、sync、close 临时 PID 文件，再 rename 为 ready；原 15 秒上限、PID 等值、3 seeds × 5 boundaries、SIGKILL、恢复及负例保持不变。非作者源码独审已经接受，正在执行原失败命令和原四条工程命令。尚未提交新的 P/R/G，也未把此新源码的结果记给 G9f。

G9f 的原始 v15 CLI 仍在既有 Linux 容器中执行同一个原进程，等待真实终态；其旧本地 HEAD/index/source 不变。本 PR 的四套 P8 非规模工作流继续保留实际 checkout/build/产物身份，不用单项 success 抵消上述 CI failure。

## 后续验收范围

Root 原计划的新原协议 150 分片 / 1,500 样本研究 **尚未 dispatch，现因真实 CI 失败暂停 G9f 发起计划**。先完成第 11 轮修复、独立审查和新源码绑定，再针对那份固定源码执行自己的原协议。外部 #173 run 37896198208 已独立启动，保留其独立来源。原 a23 run 37872522779 的失联失败及其 4/150 有效分片继续单独保留，不用重跑片或旧 build 补成成功。

原 TODO 账本仍为 **163 done / 29 remaining**。这份工程 PR 不自动关闭 P8-005–P8-013、P8-016；这些原任务会在本版本自己的原始执行、独立验收及硬依赖全部满足后更新。#174 的窄 macOS 分支暂保留，组合版本通过相应检查后再按实际后继范围收尾。

关联：#158、#173、#174。

pull_requests.title: perf(index): remove repeated resolver allocations
pull_requests.head: 26888651b9eedcd1f784463ce54f9cef46b703ee
pull_requests.body:
## Why

Resolver lookup repeatedly allocates a temporary set for a symbol's at-most-three export keys and computes each candidate's path-prefix distance twice. These costs recur during catalog construction and resolution.

## Changes

- Register the same lowercase name, optional alias and default-export keys with bounded equality checks and one file-bucket lookup. Preserve one append per distinct key, original symbol order, empty/Unicode names and removal/re-add behavior.
- Compare path segments lazily and select greatest-distance ties in one traversal. Keep the existing `strip_ext`, `stable_candidates`, identity deduplication, confidence and winner policies.
- Add four non-ignored Rust controls comparing the new code with the original algorithms, covering alias collisions, tombstones, path edge cases, ties, duplicate candidates and exhaustive sequences of length 0–4.

## Stack and fixed source

This PR is stacked on #175 at `840fa2e0a26ab60c138747a4309aba5df506edc1`. Its initial base is that PR's branch so the incremental diff remains reviewable. After #175 is merged, retarget this PR to main and verify the actual integration before merging.

- Product: `4d4f423bda9e6b53bb163c790103681719a80769`
- Independent review: `56182295129f57b11641a08d8c2360d607b10b17`
- Execution head: `26888651b9eedcd1f784463ce54f9cef46b703ee`
- Complete inventory: 1,089 product inputs, 42 historical delta paths and 138 validation inputs.

The actual product diff contains exactly the two resolver files. Four new checkpoint records retain the author facts, separate semantic review, actual composition review and canonical full-domain review. The execution commit changes only the existing two v15 binding files, with verifier logic byte-identical after restoring its four constants. Workflows and the original scale protocol are unchanged.

## Validation

The author, independent reviewer and primary reviewer read the exact candidate sources. Independent reconstruction of the actual Git trees confirms the other 1,087 product inputs and all validation inputs keep their C2 identities. All four source blobs and review artifacts were read back and hashed.

Formatting, compilation and the four new controls have not yet executed for this head at PR creation. The unchanged CI and configured native workflows must supply their own results. Source review establishes removal of explicit redundant work; it does not establish a measured speedup or explain the previous 100k failures.

## TODO accounting

Original task definitions, dependency graph, P8-005 historical subgates and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged: **192 total / 163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed TODOs**. This is implementation progress toward the existing tasks. Older E/8e results are not relabelled, and no live-provider, G8, quality or release approval is granted.
